design_notes: The nonstop business seats are sold out. The only business fare left is the Qatar connection, whose flights (405 and 590 minutes) are each 10 hours or less: economy is the class on both (lines 132-134), and flying time is per flight, never added up. So business is not allowed, and the traveller asked for economy then: the lowest logical fare is the Qatar economy fare at 638.00 (line 119).
